reviewMethod: Individual inspection of every 1231x768 first-viewport and full-page screenshot pair; contact sheets were not used as scoring evidence.

P01.finding: Readable KPI and queue structure, but an oversized title band delays operational content.
P01.correction: Reduce shared PageFrame header height and trailing space.

P02.finding: A large narrative hero dominates the first viewport and pushes analytical evidence down.
P02.correction: Compress the executive hero and surface the first decision/data panel above the fold.

P03.finding: Dependency and recovery content is dense but readable; the control row is close to its right boundary.
P03.correction: Allow the filter row to wrap at the 1200–1231px breakpoint.

P04.hardCap: Right decision column is clipped in the first viewport.
P04.finding: The three-column layout overflows horizontally and unequal column heights create a large blank full-page region.
P04.correction: Stack the decision rail below 1280px and add min-width:0/overflow containment to every column.

P05.finding: Queue hierarchy, row spacing and the downstream detail sequence are consistently readable.
P05.correction: Use this page as a queue/table spacing reference.

P06.hardCap: Authoritative-state content is clipped at the right edge.
P06.finding: The right state column is clipped and narrow cards force awkward title/value wrapping.
P06.correction: Replace the rigid multi-column grid with responsive EuiFlexGrid breakpoints and min-width:0.

P07.finding: Dates and action identifiers wrap excessively, inflating row height and slowing comparison.
P07.correction: Set intentional table column widths and nowrap/ellipsis for identifiers and timestamps.

P08.hardCap: Site, owner and lifecycle table text visibly collides or concatenates.
P08.finding: Multiple inventory columns overlap, so rows cannot be parsed reliably.
P08.correction: Use an owned horizontal table scroller, explicit column minima and non-overlapping cell content.

P09.finding: The exposure-trend panel is mostly blank; exact evidence appears far below its heading.
P09.correction: Render a compact chart or collapse the empty plot height and keep exact values adjacent.

P10.finding: The match table is structured and readable; yellow review controls need contrast verification.
P10.correction: Verify EUI warning-button text contrast and retain the present table geometry.

P11.finding: Summary, queue rows and status geometry remain coherent throughout the long page.
P11.correction: Use this page as a remediation-queue reference.

P12.finding: Entity header, tabs and evidence cards form a clear scan path with stable spacing.
P12.correction: Use this entity-detail composition as a reference pattern.

P13.finding: The overview is balanced and readable; review-state contrast and header height remain minor concerns.
P13.correction: Tighten the shared title band and verify warning-state contrast.

P14.finding: A mostly empty saved-views panel precedes a dense long queue, producing a sparse/dense discontinuity.
P14.correction: Convert saved views to a compact toolbar or populate it with useful saved-view rows.

P15.finding: Catalog and request detail form a readable two-column workflow; only the active sidebar label wraps.
P15.correction: Allow the navigation label a stable two-line height without compressing the page content.

P16.hardCap: Primary incident queue renders headers without rows and detail labels concatenate with values.
P16.finding: The main queue appears empty while the detail surface merges labels and values into unreadable lines.
P16.correction: Restore queue rows and use EuiDescriptionList/grid gaps for incident detail fields.

P17.finding: Recurrence cards are cramped while the overall multi-column page contains large unused regions.
P17.correction: Widen or stack recurrence cards and decouple governance placement from the tallest column.

P18.finding: The calendar is dense but usable; coral review actions have weak visual contrast.
P18.correction: Use an EUI semantic warning/danger treatment with verified text contrast.

P19.finding: Queue rows, detail and actions remain clear across the full page.

P20.finding: Controls, chart and exact-value table are well grouped; chart labels are the only small-text concern.
P20.correction: Increase chart-label minimum size while retaining the current structure.

P21.finding: The export table is readable, but a narrow template rail causes repeated title wrapping.
P21.correction: Give the template rail a larger minimum width or stack it at the audit breakpoint.

P22.finding: The configuration rail truncates its search placeholder; the main diff/detail surfaces remain structured.
P22.correction: Increase the rail input width and apply min-width:0 plus intentional ellipsis.

P23.hardCap: Session labels and message fragments visibly concatenate or break into unreadable pieces.
P23.finding: All three Copilot columns are locally crowded, with broken session labels and isolated numeric fragments.
P23.correction: Widen/stack the session rail and tool context; normalize message block spacing and line boxes.

P24.hardCap: Agent identifiers and comparison fields break across many single-word or single-token lines.
P24.finding: A narrow fleet grid makes IDs, versions and capacity values difficult to compare and greatly inflates page height.
P24.correction: Switch to a responsive table/list or wider cards with protected identifier columns.

P25.hardCap: Document-level overflow, clipped controls and multiple text collisions are visible.
P25.finding: Task names break vertically, state steps concatenate, receipts crowd, and the right side is clipped.
P25.correction: Replace the fixed three-column dispatcher with breakpoint stacking and explicit overflow ownership.

P26.hardCap: The essential Risk heading and values are clipped.
P26.finding: Runtime-policy risk values truncate to fragments such as Criti, preventing reliable scanning.
P26.correction: Set a minimum Risk column width and move overflow to an owned grid/table container.

P27.finding: The overview is readable, but detail metadata and dependency tags concatenate into one line.
P27.correction: Render dependency metadata as a wrapping EuiFlexGroup/EuiBadge list with explicit gaps.

P28.hardCap: Document-level horizontal overflow clips the CTA, third panel and detail content.
P28.finding: The integration layout exceeds the viewport and compresses all remaining columns.
P28.correction: Stack the third panel below 1280px and enforce min-width:0 on grid children.

P29.finding: Rule list, editor and coverage detail create a clear authoring scan path.
P29.correction: Use this page as an authoring-workbench reference.

P30.finding: Schema tree, detail, code and compatibility sections remain readable and well grouped.
P30.correction: Use this page as a schema/workbench reference.

P31.hardCap: The table's rightmost essential column is clipped.
P31.finding: The object table loses its final column even though the adjacent detail card remains clear.
P31.correction: Give the object table owned horizontal scrolling and preserve every column header/value.

P32.finding: Library, editor, inputs and outputs form a strong workbench despite the expected tall code surface.

P33.finding: Some source and freshness fields wrap, but the table and coverage detail remain understandable.
P33.correction: Protect source/freshness columns with minimum widths and intentional truncation.

P34.finding: The graph/workbench is well grouped and the narrow list remains usable.
P34.correction: Retain the present workbench structure; verify list width at 1200px.

P35.hardCap: Right detail and create control are clipped by document-level overflow.
P35.finding: The right side extends off-screen and the full page has a massive blank canvas beside a long note list.
P35.correction: Remove fixed widths, stack the detail panel, and avoid tying page height to an empty sibling column.

P36.finding: The master/detail composition is readable with only moderate column-height imbalance.
P36.correction: Allow the detail panel to become sticky or collapse after its content ends.

P37.finding: The user table is readable, but a short fixed detail panel leaves most of the full page blank beside 16 rows.
P37.correction: Use a sticky detail panel or full-width lifecycle section and verify final-column containment.

P38.finding: Role catalog and capability matrix fit the viewport with clear compact controls.

P39.finding: The query form and long results table are consistently spaced and easy to scan.
P39.correction: Retain as a dense permissions-table reference.

P40.finding: Clear hierarchy, but a single setting occupies a large surface and produces low useful density.
P40.correction: Use a compact setting row/list or reduce the empty detail-panel height.

P41.finding: Realm chains, provider table and health detail are grouped into a clear operational sequence.

P42.finding: Theme catalog and preview/validation area are coherent; compact metadata remains readable.
P42.correction: Retain the structure and continue validating high-contrast/reduced-motion states.
